### Table 1. Descriptive statistics statified by any vs. No childhood housing instability

```{r create table1s, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
datbl_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(fnlim)){
  fnlim[[i]] <- fnlim[[i]] %>%
   mutate(child_forced_move = case_when(child_forced_move==1 ~ "Childhood housing instability",
                                         child_forced_move==0 ~ "No childhood housing instability"),
           # hhincome_pp = round(hhincome_pp/1000,1),
           father_unemp = case_when(father_unemp==0 ~ "No",
                                    father_unemp==1 ~ "Yes",
                                    father_unemp==2 ~ "Never worked/always disabled",
                                    father_unemp==3 ~ "Not present/not alive"),
           raceth4 = case_when(raceth4==1 ~ "Hispanic",
                              raceth4==2 ~ "Non-Hispanic (NH) Black",
                              raceth4==3 ~ "Another NH race or unknown",
                              raceth4==4 ~ "NH White"),
           raceth4 = factor(raceth4, levels = c("Hispanic", "Non-Hispanic (NH) Black",
                                              "Another NH race or unknown", "NH White")),
           knowndeceasedsource = case_when(knowndeceasedsource==1 ~ "Participant exit interview",
                              knowndeceasedsource==2 ~ "Spouse/partner core interview",
                              knowndeceasedsource==3 ~ "Field activity date",
                              knowndeceasedsource==4 ~ "Imputed"),
           ravetrn = as.numeric(ravetrn))
  
  datbl_list[[i]] <- fnlim[[i]] %>% 
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(fu_time = max(time_start)) %>%
    filter(hrswave==min(hrswave)) %>%
    ungroup() 
}

names(datbl_list) <- c("Overall", "Childhood financial insecurity", 
                       "No childhood financial insecurity")

reg.vars<-c("hhidpn", "age_bl", "female", "raceth4", 
            "sbirth", "child_forced_move")

covars <- c("firstiw", "hrswave_first", "rabyear", "rabcohort", 
            "meduc_le8", "feduc_le8", "family_financ", "father_unemp", 
            "first_father_military", "lh4e", "high_childhood_moves_v2", 
            # "childhood_moves_v2", "child_res_instab", "child_res_instab_v2", "child_res_instab_v3",       
            "ravetrn", "married_partnered", "raeduc3", "hhincome_pp", 
            "fairpoor_shlt", "cesd_high", "adl6a_bin", "iadl5a_bin", 
            "heart", "diab", "hibp", "strok", 
            "lhms_year", "age_lhms", "age_start_median",
            "age_end2", "time_surv2", "radage", "fu_time", "eos", 
            "knowndeceasedsource")

t1.vars <- append(reg.vars, c(covars))

dat_tbl1 <- datbl_list[[1]] %>%
  select(c(any_of(t1.vars), -hhidpn, -hrswave)) 
  

labels <- list("firstiw" = "First HRS participation wave",
               "hrswave_first" = "Baseline 1998+ study wave",
               "rabcohort" = "Birth cohort",
               "female" = "Female sex/gender",
               "childhood_moves_v2" = "Childhood moves (ages 0-16)",
               "high_childhood_moves_v2" = "High childhood residential mobility (>= 4 moves)",
               "raeduc3" = "Participant educational attainment",
               "ravetrn" = "Participant veteran status",
               "shlt_bin" = "First observed fair/poor self-rated health status",
               "rabyear" = "Birth year",
               "age_bl" = "Baseline age (years)",
               "time_surv2" = "Follow-up time (years)",
               "age_lhms" = "Age at LHMS survey",
               "lhms_year" = "LHMS year",
               "raceth4" = "Race and ethnicity",
               "sbirth" = "US Southern birth",
               "lh4e" = "Experienced homelessness before age 50",
               # "child_res_instab" = "Moved in back-to-back years > once",
               # "child_res_instab_v2" = "More than 1 move in back-to-back years",
               # "child_res_instab_v3" = "Multiple moves in 5-year window",
               "father_unemp" = "Father ever unemployed during childhood",
               "first_father_military" = "Father military occupation when participant 16 YO",
               "family_financ" = "Childhood financial well-being",
               # "child_forced_move" = "Ever forced to move due to financial reasons during childhood",
               "meduc_le8" = "Mother's education <= 8th grade or missing",
               "feduc_le8" = "Father's education <= 8th grade or missing",
               "married_partnered" = "Baseline married/partnered status",
               "hhincome_pp" = "Baseline household size-adjusted income per person (1000s USD)",
               "fairpoor_shlt" = "Baseline self-reported fair/poor health",
               "cesd_high" = "Baseline elevated depressive symptoms",
               "adl6a_bin" = "Baseline self-reported >= 1 ADL",
               "iadl5a_bin" = "Baseline self-reported >= 1 IADL",
               "heart" = "Baseline self-reported heart problem",
               "diab" = "Baseline self-reported diabetes",
               "hibp" = "Baseline self-reported high blood pressure",
               "strok" = "Baseline self-reported stroke or TIA",
               "fu_time" = "Follow-up time (years)",
               "eos" = "End of study status",
               "radage" = "Death age (years)",
               "knowndeceasedsource" = "Source of death date"
               )

t1 <- dat_tbl1 %>%
  tbl_summary(
        by=child_forced_move,
        label = c(labels),
        missing = c("ifany"),
        # statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}-{p75})",
        #                  all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p})") 
        statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({IQR})",
                         all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p})")
  ) %>%
  add_overall(last=TRUE)

t1 %>%
  as_flex_table(include = everything()) %>% autofit() %>%
  set_table_properties(width = 1, layout = "autofit") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10) %>%
  flextable::line_spacing(i = 1) %>%
  flextable::font(fontname="Times New Roman", part="all") 
```

### Baseline age distribution

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
plot_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(datbl_list)){
  
  temp <- datbl_list[[i]]
  
  p <-  ggplot(temp, aes(x = age_bl, fill = child_forced_move)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Childhood housing instability" = "red3",
                               "No childhood housing instability" = "#56B4E9")) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Baseline age (years)",
       y = "Density") +
  ggtitle(names(datbl_list)[[i]])

  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# sapply(plot_list, inherits, "ggplot")
ggarrange(plot_list[[1]], plot_list[[2]], plot_list[[3]], ncol = 3)
```

## Weight distributions

### IPTWs 

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
plot_list <- list()

for(i in 1:3){
  
  p <- datbl_list[[i]] %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = all_iptw, fill = child_forced_move)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Childhood housing instability" = "red3",
                               "No childhood housing instability" = "#56B4E9")) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "IPTW",
       y = "Density") +
    ggtitle(names(datbl_list[i]))

  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

ggarrange(plot_list[[1]], plot_list[[2]], plot_list[[3]], ncol = 2) 
```


```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=8}
set.cobalt.options(binary = "std",
                   continuous = "std")
plot_list <- lapply(names(datbl_list), function(nm) {

  dat <- datbl_list[[nm]]

  bal <- bal.tab(
    child_forced_move ~
      female + raceth4 + feduc_le8 + meduc_le8 + sbirth + factor(rabcohort),
    data = dat,
    weights = dat$all_iptw,
    method = "weighting",
    un = TRUE,
    s.d.denom = "pooled"
  )

  love.plot(
    bal,
    stats = "mean.diffs",
    abs = TRUE,
    threshold = 0.1,
    var.order="alphabetical",
    sample.names = c("Original", "Weighted"),
    title = paste0(nm, "\n(", nrow(dat), ")"),
    var.names = c(
      feduc_le8 = "Low paternal education",
      meduc_le8 = "Low maternal education",
      raceth4_Hispanic = "Race and ethnicity - Hispanic",
      `raceth4_Non-Hispanic (NH) Black` = "Race and ethnicity - NH Black",
      `raceth4_NH White` = "Race and ethnicity - NH White",
      `raceth4_Another NH race or unknown` = "Race and ethnicity - Another race or unknown",
      sbirth = "US Southern birth",
      female = "Female sex/gender",
      `factor(rabcohort)_Born 1946-1964` = "Birth year - 1946-1964",
      `factor(rabcohort)_Born 1892-1927` = "Birth year - born before 1928",
      `factor(rabcohort)_Born 1965-1973` = "Birth year - 1965-1973",
      `factor(rabcohort)_Born 1928-1945` = "Birth year - 1928-1945"
    ) 
  ) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,0.25), breaks=seq(0,.25, 0.05))
})

names(plot_list) <- names(datbl_list)
ggarrange(plot_list[[1]], plot_list[[2]], plot_list[[3]],
          ncol = 3)
```

## Censoring (LTFU, death) weight evaluations

### weight distributions

```{r}
wgtdist_list <- list("dat_fnlim_all" = fnlim[[1]],
                     "dat_fnlim_insec" = fnlim[[2]],
                     "dat_fnlim_sec" = fnlim[[3]])

for(i in 1:length(wgtdist_list)){
  wgtdist_list[[i]] <- wgtdist_list[[i]] %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(wave = round(hrswave - hrswave_bl, 0)/2) %>%
    ungroup()
}
# table(wgtdist_list[[1]]$wave, exclude=NULL)
```

#### LTFU truncated weight dists

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
library(ggplot2)

p1 <- ggplot(wgtdist_list[[1]], aes(x = factor(wave), y = ipcw_time_trunc)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0.8,1.4, .1)) +
  labs(x = "Study wave", y = "Truncated censoring weight\n(loss to follow-up)",
       title = "Overall sample") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(wgtdist_list[[2]], aes(x = factor(wave), y = ipcw_time_trunc)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0.8,1.4, .1)) +
  labs(x = "Study wave", y = "Truncated censoring weight\n(loss to follow-up)",
       title = "Childhood financial insecurity sample") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(wgtdist_list[[3]], aes(x = factor(wave), y = ipcw_time_trunc)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0.8,1.4, .1)) +
  labs(x = "Study wave", y = "Truncated censoring weight\n(loss to follow-up)",
       title = "No childhood financial insecurity sample") +
  theme_minimal()

ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol=1)
```

## Missingness tables 

### Baseline sample

```{r}
preimp <- readRDS(here("Aim_2", "data", "processed", "dat_fnlim_analysis.rds"))

vars <- c("sbirth", "child_forced_move", "family_financ", "rafeduc", "rameduc",
          "raeduc", "mstat", "shlt", "heart", "diab", "hibp", "strok", 
          "itot", "hhres", "family_financ", "rabcohort")

t1miss <- preimp %>% group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  filter(hrswave == min(hrswave)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(all_of(vars))

t1 <- t1miss %>%
  tbl_summary(by=NULL,
              label = c(labels),
              list(all_categorical() ~ "{p}",
                   all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({IQR})"),
              digits = list(everything() ~ c(0))) %>%
  modify_table_styling(
    columns = label,
    row = variable == "response",
    text_format = "indent"
  )

tbl <- as_flex_table(t1,
            include = everything()) %>% autofit() %>%
  set_table_properties(width = 1, layout = "autofit") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10) %>%
  flextable::line_spacing(i = 1) 
  # flextable::font(fontname="Times New Roman", part="all") %>% print(preview = "docx")
tbl
```

## Main analysis -- time on study

### Across bl age

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
tbl <- contrasts %>%
  filter(outcome=="fnlim") %>%
  filter(sample %in% c("dat_fnlim_all", "dat_fnlim_insec", "dat_fnlim_sec") & 
           model=="md" & formula=="intx3") %>%
  filter(time %% 5 == 0)

# "",  "td.weight.time.trunc", 
wgts = c("all_iptw", "all.weight.time.trunc", "comb.weight.time.trunc")

plot_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(wgts)){
  
  temp <- tbl %>% 
  filter(weight == wgts[[i]]) 
  
  p <- ggplot(temp, aes(x=time, y=estimate)) +
  geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.7, color = "#51A687") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=LL, ymax=UL),
                  width=.2, linewidth=1,  color = "#51A687",
                  position=position_dodge(0.05), alpha=.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  facet_nested(age_bl_f ~ sample_f, switch="y") +
  xlab("Time on study (years)") +
  ylab("Mean difference (95% CI)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.justification = "center",
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size=13),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15), # Changes "Weight" and "MPG" size
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1.5), breaks = seq(-1.5,1.5,by=.5)) + 
  ggtitle(temp$weight_f[1])

  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

plot_list[[1]]
plot_list[[2]]
plot_list[[3]]
```

## Overall only

#### MD difference tables 

##### IPTW 
```{r}
tbl <- contrasts %>%
  filter(outcome=="fnlim") %>%
  filter(sample %in% c("dat_fnlim_all", "dat_fnlim_insec", "dat_fnlim_sec") & 
           model=="md" & formula=="intx3") %>%
  filter(time %% 5 == 0 & weight=="all_iptw") %>%
  mutate(across(c("estimate", "LL", "UL"), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  mutate(md_clean = paste0(estimate, " (", LL, ", ", UL, ")")) %>%
  select(c(time, age_bl, sample_f, md_clean)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(age_bl, time, sample_f) 

tab2 <- tbl %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(time),
                            values_from = md_clean) 

tab2 %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_table_properties(width = 1, layout = "autofit") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10) %>%
  flextable::line_spacing(i = 1) %>%
  flextable::font(fontname="Times New Roman", part="all") 
```

tbl <- preds %>%
  filter(outcome=="fnlim") %>%

plot_list <- list()

for(i in 1:length(wgts)){
  
  temp <- tbl %>% 
  filter(weight == wgts[[i]]) 
  
  p <- ggplot(temp, aes(x=time, y=emmean, color=as_factor(child_forced_move))) +
  geom_line(size=1.5, alpha=0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=pmax(0,lower.CL), ymax=upper.CL,
                  fill=as_factor(child_forced_move)),
                  width=.2, linewidth=0,
                  position=position_dodge(0.05), alpha=.3) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  facet_nested(age_bl_f ~ sample_f, switch="y") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  xlab("Time on study (years)") +
  ylab("Functional impairment score") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Childhood housing instability" = "red3",
                               "No childhood housing instability" = "#56B4E9")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Childhood housing instability" = "red3", 
                                "No childhood housing instability" = "#56B4E9")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-.2,6.2), breaks=seq(0,6,by=1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.justification = "center",
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size=18),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20), # Changes "Weight" and "MPG" size
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle(temp$weight_f[1])

  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}
